contact.faqBookingQ: How do I book a table?
contact.faqBookingA: Go through the page of the house you have in mind: you'll find its booking form or its phone number there. All our venues are on the <link>Subsidiaries</link> page. For a group, or a request covering several houses, write to us through the <form>contact form</form>.

contact.faqPrivateQ: Can we book a venue for a private event?
contact.faqPrivateA: Yes, our venues also host private events. Describe your project (date, number of guests, preferred house) in the <form>contact form</form> and our team will reply within 48 hours.
contact.faqEventsQ: How can I keep up with your events?
contact.faqEventsA: The calendar for all our houses is on the <link>Events</link> page. Each house also announces its nights on its social accounts, gathered just below.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How we handle your information when you use our site or contact us.
privacy.controllerBody: The processing described below is carried out by {name}. To exercise your rights:
privacy.collectedBody: When you send a message (name, email address, subject, content), we use this information solely to answer your request and for legitimate follow-up.
privacy.analyticsBody: Depending on the site's final configuration, cookies or trackers may be used (see the cookie policy). To be adapted to your analytics solution, or its absence.
privacy.rightsBody: Under the conditions set by applicable regulations, you may request access to, rectification or erasure of your data, as well as restriction of processing, portability, or object to certain processing. You may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
privacy.retentionBody: Contact messages are kept for as long as needed to handle the exchange, then archived or deleted in line with your legal and operational obligations.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: What you need to know about any trackers that may be set during your visit.
cookies.whatBody: A cookie is a small file stored on your device when you visit a website. Depending on how the site is actually set up, it may serve a technical purpose (security, preferences) or audience measurement.
cookies.usedBody: The current showcase site mainly uses cookies required for its technical operation. To be updated if you add third-party social networks, a Google Maps map, advertising, Matomo / GA4, etc.
cookies.necessaryBody: Proper operation of the site (e.g. load balancing, language preferences).
cookies.analyticsBody: Only after configuration and, unless exempt, consent (to be documented precisely).
cookies.choicesBody: You can configure your browser to refuse all or some cookies. For a compliant consent banner (Tarteaucitron, Axeptio, etc.), plan a dedicated integration.
